target.title: Resolving Sharp Gradients of Unstable Singularities to Machine Precision via Neural Networks
target.leg_175_read_depth: abstract, p.2 sec.1, p.11 sec.2.3.3 only

authorship.note: a locatable fact about who wrote what, consistent with the CAP being a separate track; NOT an inference about intent.

gate.question: Does the authors' later work (post-obstruction-removal) state, imply, or make locatable an actual certificate for the unstable singularities arXiv:2509.14185 reported at CAP-ready precision, and if not, what NEW obstruction (if any) does it name?

cap_mentions_exhaustive.text: providing an important ingredient for bridging the gap between numerical discovery and computer-assisted proofs for unstable phenomena in nonlinear PDEs.
Their rigorous mathematical validation via computer-assisted proofs (CAP) generally demands extremely high numerical accuracy [2].
Obtaining robust numerical approximations is paramount for better simulations and rigorous computer-assisted proofs.
Beyond numerical discovery, high accuracy is a prerequisite for rigorous mathematical verification via computer-assisted proofs.

quotes.text: providing an important ingredient for bridging the gap between numerical discovery and computer-assisted proofs for unstable phenomena in nonlinear PDEs.
quotes.bears_on: the paper's own description of its contribution: an ingredient, not a bridge

quotes.text: Beyond numerical discovery, high accuracy is a prerequisite for rigorous mathematical verification via computer-assisted proofs.
quotes.bears_on: the paper's last word on certification -- future-facing, nothing claimed

quotes.text: We demonstrate our method on two canonical models: the 1D Cordoba-Cordoba-Fontelos equation and the 2D Incompressible Porous Media equation.
quotes.bears_on: Boussinesq and 3D Euler with boundary -- leg 175's open item (a) -- are outside the follow-up's scope entirely

quotes.text: a persistent non-smooth signal at the origin (inset of Fig.3b) remains for all tested lambda in [0.455, 0.4713]. This indicates that if a third unstable solution exists, it is located at a lambda value corresponding to an even higher-gradient profile.
quotes.bears_on: NEW obstruction N2: the discovery frontier itself stalled on CCF

quotes.text: The challenge of exploring the range lambda < 0.455 and resolving such a feature in the 1D CCF model appears to be even greater than finding highly unstable solutions in the 2D IPM equation.
quotes.bears_on: the authors rate the remaining 1D search harder than the 2D one

quotes.text: the high-gradient nature of higher-order unstable modes still reduces the convergence rate of training. For a fixed computational budget ... the achievable background PDE residual for the smooth solution increases by approximately one order of magnitude for each successive singularity
quotes.bears_on: leg 175's ladder, re-verified at the primary source

quotes.text: decreases the achievable lambda accuracy for a fixed computational budget by approximately two orders of magnitude per model.
quotes.bears_on: NEW obstruction N1: the ladder now degrades the enclosure width of lambda, which is what a self-similar CAP must enclose

quotes.text: Figure 6(f) shows the best inferred lambda for different singularities of IPM using a multistage setup that can be implemented on a single A100 GPU (80GB). To further improve the lambda accuracy, one could use larger networks or more training stages in parallel on multiple GPUs.
quotes.bears_on: NEW obstruction N3: the remedy offered is budget, not method

quotes.text: we refer to machine precision as the highest achievable accuracy, where the remaining PDE residuals are dominated by the inherent round-off errors of double-float arithmetic, typically O(10^-13) or lower.
quotes.bears_on: N3: the floor is double-float round-off, by the pipeline's own definition

leg_175_open_items_recheck.item: the precision fix is unpublished for Boussinesq / 3D Euler with boundary
leg_175_open_items_recheck.evidence: FIX sec.2 l.130 names its two models as CCF and IPM only; 'Boussinesq' occurs 2x in 27 pp (abstract recap of [1]; ref [2] title) and never in the body. Leg 175's ~4.8-decade Boussinesq gap is untouched.
leg_175_open_items_recheck.leg_175_magnitude: 4.82 decades short of O(10^-13) at Boussinesq's best solution

leg_175_open_items_recheck.evidence: FIX sec.2.3.3 l.684-696 states it in the paper's own words and it is now the BINDING constraint, expressed in lambda rather than in residual (see N1).

leg_175_open_items_recheck.item: the unstable-spectrum enclosure (a proof obligation, not a numerics one)
leg_175_open_items_recheck.evidence: ZERO occurrences of 'eigen' in the follow-up; no linearized-operator spectrum, no mode-count re-derivation, no treatment of eigenvalues off the real axis or outside the symmetry class. The paper that fixed the numerics did not touch it.
leg_175_open_items_recheck.leg_175_magnitude: not a quantity -- an assumption stated as 'desirable' in USC p.19

leg_175_open_items_recheck.item: the CAP announced Sep 2025 as 'Manuscript in preparation'
leg_175_open_items_recheck.evidence: FIX never mentions it; eight independent search venues this pass returned no such record (see SEARCH_LOG).

new_obstructions.name: the binding quantity moved from the residual to lambda's error bar
new_obstructions.detail: Residuals are at double-float round-off O(10^-13), but the scaling parameter lambda -- the object a self-similar blow-up certificate must enclose -- is pinned only to +-1e-7 at IPM's 4th unstable mode.
new_obstructions.why_new: leg 175 recorded the ladder as a RESIDUAL margin against the CAP threshold. The full text shows that margin is paid off and the ladder now degrades the ENCLOSURE WIDTH of lambda instead.

new_obstructions.name: the discovery frontier stalled: CCF's 3rd unstable searched, not found
new_obstructions.detail: Searched across lambda in [0.455, 0.4713] with a persistent non-smooth signal at every tested value; the authors place the remaining search below 0.455 and rate it harder than the 2D IPM problem. 'the full suite of previously discovered CCF solutions' is a suite of THREE.
new_obstructions.why_new: not visible from the abstract, which reports only what was resolved.

new_obstructions.name: the remaining margin is hardware- and arithmetic-bound, not conceptual
new_obstructions.detail: The floor is double-float round-off by the pipeline's own definition of success, and every remedy offered for lambda accuracy is budget (larger networks, a third stage, more GPUs; the reported results fit one A100 80GB). A certificate generally needs arithmetic TIGHTER than the object it encloses.
new_obstructions.why_new: leg 175 read the fix as removing a method barrier; the full text shows what replaced it is a precision-arithmetic barrier.

new_obstructions.name: third-party: low PDE residual does not discriminate accurate from inaccurate PINN solutions
new_obstructions.locator: arXiv:2606.25151 (McShannon, Dietrich, Jun 2026), which cites USC as [1]-class prior art; https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.25151
new_obstructions.detail: Parameter-poisoned PINNs reach loss at or below the clean baseline while differing from the true solution by large margins, on Burgers, an NS cavity and convection-diffusion.
new_obstructions.why_new: post-dates leg 175's pass. NOT the authors' own, and NOT on the singularity problems -- it makes no claim of error in USC or FIX. Recorded because it is the independent statement of why N1-N3 matter: a small residual is evidence, an enclosure is a proof.

lambda_enclosure_ladder.note: the fitted rate is over the BEST achieved lambda (Fig.7f); the stated rate is at FIXED computational budget. Related but not identical quantities -- they are expected to agree only in order of magnitude, and they do.

ccf_third_unstable_search.authors_difficulty_rating: greater than finding highly unstable solutions in 2D IPM

search_log.outcome: exactly two relevant records; the other 14 are unrelated senses of unstable/singularities. Identical to leg 175's result 8 months later.

search_log.query: all:"unstable singularities" AND all:"self-similar" (leg 175 query, re-run)

search_log.outcome: 7 records, newest arXiv:2605.03920 (Burgers-Hilbert linear instability, May 2026). No CAP for unstable singularities.

search_log.query: abs:"Cordoba-Cordoba-Fontelos" OR abs:"incompressible porous media" AND abs:"computer-assisted"
search_log.outcome: 3 records: the same two, plus Kiselev 2010. No CAP.
v1 only, no v2, no journal reference
22 citing papers; NONE is a certificate for these singularities. Nearest are FIX itself and arXiv:2606.25151 (see N4).

search_log.query: Gomez-Serrano's own 2025-2026 list (the CAP author on the original)
search_log.outcome: nothing on a CAP for unstable self-similar singularities; his 2026 submissions are biharmonic nodal loops, Burgers-Hilbert, polygon eigenvalues, and the Tao/Wagner exploration paper.

same two papers plus secondary coverage (Quanta 2026-01-09; a NASA Ames seminar page 2026-03-05; an LIMS event page). No primary source announcing a certificate. Secondary coverage was used for NO claim.

what_would_have_changed_the_answer: any of searches 1/2/4 returning a third record; search 5 showing a v2 with a validation section; search 6 surfacing a CAP among the 22 citers; search 7 listing one.

ceiling.note: literature-only leg on someone else's inviscid, uncertified numerics. The one item touching this repository's agenda is leg 175's item (c): the unstable-spectrum enclosure is a PROOF obligation, and the paper that fixed the numerics did not touch it.
